identity.title: Observing the Sun with the Atacama Large Millimeter/submillimeter Array (ALMA): High-Resolution Interferometric Imaging

paper_type_evidence.quote: We describe the commissioning efforts that enable the use of two frequency bands, the 3 mm band (Band 3) and the 1.25 mm band (Band 6), for continuum interferometric-imaging observations of the Sun with ALMA.

evidence.quote: South Pole | 13:31 – 14:32UT

question.value: How can ALMA be commissioned and calibrated for continuum interferometric imaging of the Sun in Bands 3 and 6, and what do the resulting science-verification images show?

evidence.quote: Examples of high-resolution synthesized images obtained using the newly commissioned modes during the solar commissioning campaign held in December 2015 are presented.
This article makes use of the following ALMA data: ADS/JAO.ALMA#2011.0.00020.SV, ADS/JAO.ALMA#2011.0.00001.CAL.

bands.value: Band 3 (3 mm) and Band 6 (1.25 mm) continuum

evidence.quote: two frequency bands, the 3 mm band (Band 3) and the 1.25 mm band (Band 6)

evidence.quote: the observing frequency of the solar images shown in this article is the same as the frequency of the first LO: 100 GHz for Band 3, 239 GHz for Band 6.
